label: Tabs

accessibility.rule: TabsList requires aria-label or aria-labelledby. Radix provides tab roles, selection and automatic/manual keyboard activation.

Initially selected tabs are revealed immediately. Later selections scroll only the tab viewport, with reduced motion respected. Focused tabs are revealed in manual activation mode without changing selection.
Scroll controls derive disabled boundaries by default, support horizontal LTR/RTL and vertical layouts, and do not change the selected tab.

notes: Events are framework-specific and omitted from this contract.

TabsList showScrollButtons defaults to false. When true, built-in controls scroll by 75% of the viewport. Explicit startScrollButtonDisabled/endScrollButtonDisabled values override automatic boundaries.
React scroll-button click handlers replace built-in movement when supplied. The forwarded TabsList ref still targets the tablist, not the internal scroll viewport.
Scrollable lists work with or without buttons. Selection and layout changes reveal the active tab; manual scrolling does not reset to the active tab.

For horizontal TabsList, className styles the navigation wrapper. Setting its height or min-height stretches the inner list and triggers together, including scrollable lists with or without scroll buttons. The default minimum tab height and vertical scrolling layout are preserved.
Routing, persistence, close confirmation, next-selection policy and focus restoration after closing remain caller responsibilities.
